players.product: boiler + steam-turbine power plants (coal / natural gas, enhanced combined cycle) for AI data-center campuses (Base Electron project, North Dakota)

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K: on November 4, 2025 B&W entered a limited notice to proceed (LNTP) with Applied Digital for a project to design and install four 300-megawatt natural gas-fired power plants consisting of boilers and associated steam turbines to deliver power for an AI factory. Effective February 26, 2026 it entered the Definitive Agreement with Base Electron, an IPP backed by Applied Digital, to complete the design and installation of the four plants; the total consideration is up to $2.4 billion, of which $2.0 billion is variable (based on time and materials expended and subject to change orders) and the remaining is fixed. The plant is targeted to begin operation in 2028. With this project, B&W's backlog would be $2.8 billion in total as the related work scope is authorized and written commitments are received from the customer.
quarterly_data.figure: four 300-megawatt gas-fired plants; total consideration up to $2.4 billion ($2.0 billion variable); operation targeted 2028; backlog would be $2.8 billion

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K: backlog (total remaining performance obligations) was $423.6 million at December 31, 2025, versus $495.2 million at December 31, 2024. Of the December 31, 2025 backlog, B&W expected to recognize $380.7 million in 2026, $38.2 million in 2027 and $4.7 million thereafter (approximately 90%, 9% and 1%).
quarterly_data.figure: backlog $423.6 million (December 31, 2025) vs $495.2 million; $380.7 million expected in 2026

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K: revenues for the year ended December 31, 2025 were $587,676 thousand versus $581,039 thousand in 2024 (2025 by type: Parts $241,580 thousand, Projects $186,914 thousand, Construction $159,182 thousand); United States revenues were $418,002 thousand.

10-K customer concentration: B&W had one customer that comprised more than 10% of its consolidated revenues in 2025 (XBRL: one customer, 10% of revenue) and no single customer comprised 10% or more of consolidated revenues in 2024 or 2023. The customer is not named.
quarterly_data.figure: one unnamed customer more than 10% of 2025 consolidated revenues

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K supply: B&W's operations use raw materials such as carbon and alloy steels, components and accessories for assembly, which are available from numerous sources and purchased as needed for individual contracts; B&W does not depend on a single source of supply for any significant raw materials and does not believe any serious shortage presently exists.
